idea-plugin.name: Any Progress Bar
idea-plugin.description: Animal and Tung Tung Tung Sahur themed progress bars with a built-in design editor. Choose from the built-in presets or combine your own PNG, JPG and SVG object, trail and background images, colours and motion. Configure under Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Any Progress Bar.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• New motion types: hop, spin, pulse, bob and ping-pong.
  • One shared animation timer for all bars; it stops when every bar is idle or hidden.
  • Very short bars (under 12 px) are drawn as a plain fill instead of unreadable artwork.
  • Raster images are cached per size; SVGs are capped at 5000 elements / 32 levels.
  • Export and import designs as shareable .apbdesign files.
  • A broken or missing image no longer disables the whole design; only that layer is skipped.
  • Background colour now has an IDE colour swatch and a "Use IDE colour" button.
